en.text: But say the things which fit sound doctrine,

zhSimplified.text: 但你所讲的总要合乎那纯正的道理。

zhTraditional.text: 但你所講的總要合乎那純正的道理。

en.text: that older men should be temperate, sensible, sober minded, sound in faith, in love, and in perseverance,

zhSimplified.text: 劝老年人要有节制、端庄、自守，在信心、爱心、忍耐上都要纯全无疵。

zhTraditional.text: 勸老年人要有節制、端莊、自守，在信心、愛心、忍耐上都要純全無疵。

en.text: and that older women likewise be reverent in behavior, not slanderers nor enslaved to much wine, teachers of that which is good,

zhSimplified.text: 又劝老年妇人，举止行动要恭敬，不说谗言，不给酒作奴仆，用善道教训人，

zhTraditional.text: 又勸老年婦人，舉止行動要恭敬，不說讒言，不給酒作奴僕，用善道教訓人，

en.text: that they may train the young wives to love their husbands, to love their children,

zhSimplified.text: 好指教少年妇人，爱丈夫，爱儿女，

zhTraditional.text: 好指教少年婦人，愛丈夫，愛兒女，

en.text: to be sober minded, chaste, workers at home, kind, being in subjection to their own husbands, that God’s word may not be blasphemed.

zhSimplified.text: 谨守，贞洁，料理家务，待人有恩，顺服自己的丈夫，免得 神的道理被毁谤。

zhTraditional.text: 謹守，貞潔，料理家務，待人有恩，順服自己的丈夫，免得上帝的道理被毀謗。

en.text: Likewise, exhort the younger men to be sober minded.
In all things show yourself an example of good works. In your teaching, show integrity, seriousness, incorruptibility,

zhSimplified.text: 你自己凡事要显出善行的榜样；在教训上要正直、端庄，

zhTraditional.text: 你自己凡事要顯出善行的榜樣；在教訓上要正直、端莊，

en.text: and soundness of speech that can’t be condemned, that he who opposes you may be ashamed, having no evil thing to say about us.

zhSimplified.text: 言语纯全，无可指责，叫那反对的人，既无处可说我们的不是，便自觉羞愧。

zhTraditional.text: 言語純全，無可指責，叫那反對的人，既無處可說我們的不是，便自覺羞愧。

en.text: Exhort servants to be in subjection to their own masters and to be well-pleasing in all things, not contradicting,

zhSimplified.text: 劝仆人要顺服自己的主人，凡事讨他的喜欢，不可顶撞他，

zhTraditional.text: 勸僕人要順服自己的主人，凡事討他的喜歡，不可頂撞他，

en.text: not stealing, but showing all good fidelity, that they may adorn the doctrine of God, our Savior, in all things.

zhSimplified.text: 不可私拿东西，要显为忠诚，以致凡事尊荣我们救主— 神的道。

zhTraditional.text: 不可私拿東西，要顯為忠誠，以致凡事尊榮我們救主－上帝的道。

en.text: For the grace of God has appeared, bringing salvation to all men,

zhSimplified.text: 因为 神救众人的恩典已经显明出来，

zhTraditional.text: 因為上帝救眾人的恩典已經顯明出來，

en.text: instructing us to the intent that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we would live soberly, righteously, and godly in this present age;

zhSimplified.text: 教训我们除去不敬虔的心和世俗的情欲，在今世自守、公义、敬虔度日，

zhTraditional.text: 教訓我們除去不敬虔的心和世俗的情慾，在今世自守、公義、敬虔度日，

en.text: looking for the blessed hope and appearing of the glory of our great God and Savior, Jesus Christ,

zhSimplified.text: 等候所盼望的福，并等候至大的 神和我们救主耶稣基督的荣耀显现。

zhTraditional.text: 等候所盼望的福，並等候至大的上帝和我們救主耶穌基督的榮耀顯現。

en.text: who gave himself for us, that he might redeem us from all iniquity and purify for himself a people for his own possession, zealous for good works.

zhSimplified.text: 他为我们舍了自己，要赎我们脱离一切罪恶，又洁净我们，特作自己的子民，热心为善。

zhTraditional.text: 他為我們捨了自己，要贖我們脫離一切罪惡，又潔淨我們，特作自己的子民，熱心為善。

en.text: Say these things and exhort and reprove with all authority. Let no one despise you.

zhSimplified.text: 这些事你要讲明，劝戒人，用各等权柄责备人；不可叫人轻看你。

zhTraditional.text: 這些事你要講明，勸戒人，用各等權柄責備人；不可叫人輕看你。
